breakpoints.note: First project parser statement that materializes the accepted MQTT packet extent from attacker-controlled header bytes. `mg_mqtt_next_prop()` later derives its `end` pointer from this exact datagram length.

The `MQTT_PROP_TYPE_BINARY_DATA` branch trusts the attacker-declared 16-bit payload length and advances `new_pos` without checking that `i + 2 + prop->val.len` stays below `end`. The fix adds that missing payload bound check before returning the property.
